text:
Andrea (Product): AM check-in — quick sync: what I did / blockers / today
Andrea (Product): Did: finalized the rollout plan for the new routing priority (docs + sequence of canaries). Uploaded the spec to the drive: https://redwood.docs/s/route-priority-v2
Andrea (Product): Blocked: waiting on infra quota confirmation for an extra GPU node for the canary region (us-west-2). @mason could you re-open the quota ticket?
Mason (Eng): On it — I pinged eng-infra earlier, reopening ticket now. Should have an update in ~2 hours.
Mason (Eng): Did: merged the model-variant selector PR (link: https://gh.redwood/eng/selector/pull/812) — there is one smoke test failing on longer seq lengths, looking into perf regression.
Mason (Eng): Blocker: perf regression shows ~12% higher p99 for seq > 2k in the canary harness. Suspect kernel fallback on the new attention op.
Maya (QA): I can run focused perf/test with the harness and capture traces. If you drop the failing input set to /tmp/perf-cases I can run nightly and attach logs.
Mason (Eng): Thanks — dropping a small set now. Command I ran locally:
```
./run_harness --suite canary --seq-length 2048 --model redwood-base-q4f
```
Mason (Eng): Logs go to /var/tmp/canary-logs on my machine; will upload to the shared bucket when ready.
Andrea (Product): FYI: If infra quota is delayed more than 6h, fallback plan is to run the canary on existing pool but reduce concurrency and enable prefix-caching. That increases token cost but keeps rollout timeline. Agree? :thinking_face:
Priya (Design): Quick note — UX for routing fallbacks needs an info banner in Console so customers understand changed latency/cost during canary. I sketched two variants in the Figma file: https://figma.redwood/route-fallbacks
Priya (Design): Could we surface a short message like: "Temporary routing mode: conservative (increased cost, reduced concurrency)" so it's clear in the console without deep docs.
Andrea (Product): Love that — please add exact copy to the spec, I'll attach it to the rollout plan.
Maya (QA): Running the harness now against Mason's perf-case set. ETA ~45m. I'll post results here and create an issue if regressions remain.
deploy-bot: Build #2841 started for canary branch — status: queued.
Mason (Eng): If the regression persists I'll try forcing the older kernel path as a short-term mitigation. That needs one more small PR; I can have it ready today.
Andrea (Product): Today: coordinate infra ticket + monitor Maya's perf run + finalize canary announcement copy (email + Console banner).
Maya (QA): Update: first run done, p99 still ~10% above baseline on seq=2048. Capturing traces and screenshots now, will post artifacts to the ticket: https://redwood.issues/INF-764
Mason (Eng): Received the logs — the trace shows a fallback at attention_kernel_dispatch. I'll instrument additional metrics and open PR to force the previous kernel variant as a toggle: `ATTN_KERNEL_FORCE=legacy`
Andrea (Product): Thanks team. @mason if you can get the toggle PR up, and Eng-Infra confirms quota within 6h, we can proceed with canary as planned; otherwise we flip to fallback plan.
Priya (Design): I'll drop the banner copy into the spec in 30m.
Maya (QA): Will re-run tests after toggle PR is merged. If green, I'll sign off on canary smoke.
Andrea (Product): All right — I'll ping legal for the customer communication draft once the banner copy is in. :thumbsup:
